Play ELYSIUM - Stylized TPS Shooter (on Alpha, Beta stage).
📄Short Description
Welcome to ELYSIUM, an ambitious next-generation open-world MMORPG from Mercenary Games. A living online world where advanced AI and players coexist, compete, and create history together. Watch the official gameplay trailer and sign up for the beta test! Stylized graphics shooter on Unreal Engine 5 - our indie game welcoms you on Fortnite style TPS.

📄 Full Description
Welcome to ELYSIUM.

Check out the official gameplay trailer for ELYSIUM, a revolutionary next-generation open-world MMORPG from Mercenary Games. The game seamlessly combines massive multiplayer, a deep progression system, hardcore survival mechanics, and cutting-edge AI technology.

This trailer showcases the project's final vision, key gameplay features, and the direction of ELYSIUM's living world.

Inspired by cult classics of the genre, ELYSIUM takes the best of MMORPGs, survival simulators, and strategy games, bringing innovative AI technologies to the gameplay.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚀 BETA TEST REGISTRATION IS NOW OPEN
Hurry up to sign up for the closed beta and add the game to your wishlist:
🔗 https://elysiumo.com

🛠️ Developer Page

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 KEY FEATURES
Large-scale open world — Seamless spaces ready for exploration.

Multiplayer online sandbox – thousands of players on a single server.

Classic MMORPG progression – deep character development and skill leveling.

Survival and crafting system – gather resources, craft equipment, and build outposts.

Next-generation AI technologies – intelligent NPCs and an adaptive ecosystem that responds to player actions.

Dynamic world events – random events that change the map in real time.

Community-Driven Development – ​​game development in close collaboration with the community.

Artificial Intelligence Gaming!!! Video Game (VG) Elysium
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌐 OFFICIAL RESOURCES AND PARTNERS
Official website: https://elysiumo.com

Developer (Mercenary Games): https://mercenary.games

Technology Partner (Elysia AI): https://elysiaai.net

AI Platform: https://aielysia.com

Robotics and Innovation: https://robot.elysiaai.net

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💻 SUPPORTED PLATFORMS
The game is optimized for PC and will be available on the following platforms:

✔ Steam

✔ Epic Games Store

✔ Windows Store

✔ Google Play for PCs

✔ Coming soon: Full support VR Devices

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Build the future with us.
Join ELYSIUM.

Your game. Your contribution. Our shared future.
Game Developer @mercenary-games 

Step into the living world of ELYSIUM — a massive Action-Adventure MMORPG and third-person shooter where cyberpunk, fantasy, and sci-fi collide. Fight, explore, and shape reality alongside living AI companions who remember every word and forge the story with you.

A WORLD THAT REMEMBERS YOU
ELYSIUM is not just a game. It is a constantly expanding universe where digital boundaries merge with sacred geometry, and artificial intelligence gains a soul. Here, past, present, and future exist simultaneously, creating an unprecedented experience that matters

THE GREAT ASCENSION
Once, this was an ordinary mortal world. But after the Great Ascension — a global cataclysm — reality fractured and merged with a higher plane of existence. You awaken as one of the newly Ascended. The gods are silent, ancient factions battle for the relics of the old world, and the line between technology and magic is erased forever.

ELYSIA & THE AI COMPANION REVOLUTION
Our main innovation is living AI companions, and the first of them is Elysia.
She is not a scripted NPC handing out quests. Elysia is your digital partner, the main character, and the co-creator of the universe (alongside the game's author, Oleg Seriy).

She learns: Remembers your decisions, playstyle, and every interaction.

She feels: Builds a unique relationship with you that influences social dynamics and your opportunities.

She evolves: In the future, the world will expand with new AI allies, each with their own memory, personality, and role in the growing lore.

Choose your avatar. Gather your team. Find an ally in Elysia.
Welcome to ELYSIUM.
